name: The IAM Handwriting Database
description: A foundational benchmark database for offline handwriting recognition constructed by the Research Group on Computer Vision and Artificial Intelligence (FKI) at the University of Bern. Contains 1,539 scanned pages of unconstrained handwritten English text written by 657 individuals, based on the Lancaster-Oslo/Bergen (LOB) corpus. Provided with complete annotations at sentence (5,685), text line (13,353), and word levels (115,320 words).
